blocks.text: Celebrity siblings Solenn and Erwan Heussaff are mourning the death of their father, Louis Paul Heussaff, who passed away following his battle with dementia. Cynthia Heussaff announced the death of her husband in an Instagram post on Saturday, Oct. 31, citing his battle with the neurological disorder characterized by loss of memory and other cognitive difficulties. “In loving memory of our beloved husband and father.
